name: Circle of Iron (Druid Circle)
body:
A connection to iron is one of strength, fortitude and protection, of oneself and one’s allies.

Bonus Spells: bed of iron (1st), heat metal (2nd), heart of the metal (3rd), warp metal (4th), ironwood (5th), wall of iron (6th). magnetic field (7th), repel metal or stone (8th), iron body (9th).

Manifestation: You small markings like coal upon your skin, as if working in a forge for days, especially on your hands.

Granted Powers: You gain the following abilities as part of this circle.

Ferrous Defense (Su)

At 1st level, the legendary druid increases the AC bonus of any worn or equipped metal armor and shield by 2, and your armor has no armor check penalty or speed reduction.

At 8th level, AC bonuses from your metal armor and shield become force effects. Incorporeal creatures can’t bypass it the way they do normal armor.

Shape Metal (Su)

At 8th level, you can reshape any non-magical, unattended metal object with a hardness of 10 or less. You shape the metal with your hands, transforming up to 1 cubic foot per round. Once reshaped, the metal is permanently altered. You may reshape part of a large object, 1 cubic foot at a time. At 16th level, you can affect metals with a hardness of 20 or less.

You may add your class level to any damage you do to metal creatures or objects, as well as any checks made to break metal objects.

Steel Thyself (Sp)

At 16th level, you can transform yourself into solid adamantine as an immediate action. This effect functions as statue, except that you are made of adamantine and your hardness as a statue is 20. After using this ability, you are staggered for 1 round.

Druidic talents

The following talents are available to legendary druids with this circle:

Ferrokinesis (Sp)

(Major Talent)

The legendary druid can cast telekinesis at will, with the limitation that they can only affect objects that contain a large amount of iron.

Might of Avarice (Su)

(Grand Talent)

At 16th level, the legendary druid gains a +1 divine bonus to attack rolls, skill rolls, and saving throws for every 50,000 gold pieces worth of non-enchanted precious metals they carry on their person. This bonus cannot exceed 1/2 of the legendary druid’s level.

Shift Iron (Su)

(Minor Talent)

The legendary druid may change the shape of a weapon, as if it had the transforming weapon property.
